verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Canny embedding its widget into the developer's own website or app, an API reference, an MCP server for external LLM tools, and first-party native integrations. None of it documents a framework for developers to build custom integrations that render and run inside Canny's own interface. Those items are adjacent capabilities or building blocks and earn no credit toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build custom integrations that appear and operate directly inside the product's own interface
